name: EBMUD Customer Assistance Program
description: 50% off water charges and 35% off wastewater charges for income-eligible customers
fullDescription: The East Bay Municipal Utility District (EBMUD) Customer Assistance Program (CAP) provides discounts on water and wastewater bills for income-eligible residential customers and eligible homeless shelters in Alameda and Contra Costa counties.
whatTheyOffer:
- 50% off the standard bimonthly water service charge
- 50% off home water use, up to 1,050 gallons per person per month
- 35% off EBMUD wastewater service and flow charges
- Discounts for eligible homeless shelters
- Payment extensions and payment arrangements
howToGetIt:
1. Check income limits: $67,900 or less for 1-2 people, $76,400 for 3, $84,850 for 4, $91,650 for 5, $98,450 for 6 (add $6,800 per additional person)
2. Home must be your primary residence with its own individual water meter
3. Apply online, or download an application, call 510-287-0468, or pick one up at 375 11th St., Oakland
4. Submit the application and proof of income by email (cap@ebmud.com), mail, or fax
5. Reapply every two years to keep the discount (not retroactive)
keywords: EBMUD, water bill, discount, low-income, East Bay, Alameda County, Contra Costa, wastewater, utility assistance
